Summary.Name: MedGemma _.5
Summary.Description: MedGemma is a collection of Gemma 3 variants that are trained for performance on medical text and image comprehension. Developers can use MedGemma to accelerate building healthcare-based AI applications.

Uses_and_directions.General_use: This model can be used to perform medical text and image comprehension.
Uses_and_directions.Target_population_and_use_case: This model is intended for use in the healthcare field to assist in the diagnosis of medical text and image comprehension.
Uses_and_directions.Before_using_this_model: Before using this model, please ensure that the input data is in the correct format and that the model is trained on the appropriate data.

Warnings_and_limitations.Image_Quality: The model requires high-quality medical text and image.
Warnings_and_limitations.Multiple_Devices: The model is designed to perform medical text and image comprehension.
Warnings_and_limitations.Confidence_Scores: Current threshold applied on probability output for classification is 0.1
